Pre-review citation sweep against current `origin/main` (this description's cites are pinned to `083620b0`, now **333 commits** behind). Done before requesting review so the gate does not spend 15-20 minutes rediscovering it. Three findings; the first is blocking.

## 1. AC1 is unsatisfiable as written — BLOCKING

AC1 requires `git grep -n '_ALIASES\b\|_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES\|_map_legacy_env' -- src tests scripts` to come back empty. It cannot, no matter how correct the implementation is. `\b` anchors the *end* of the identifier, so `_ALIASES\b` also matches the tail of every unrelated name ending in `_ALIASES`. Run verbatim on `origin/main`, **19 hits survive that this story must not touch**:

- `scripts/ensure_pandoc.py:50,94` — `_ARCH_ALIASES`
- `src/rebar/_cli/_help_route.py:31,64,183,186,190` — `_HIDDEN_ALIASES`, `_REMOVED_SIMPLE_CLI_ALIASES`
- `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:565` — `_HIDDEN_ALIASES`
- `src/rebar/_commands/composer_edit.py:210,388` — `_EDIT_FLAG_ALIASES`
- `src/rebar/llm/providers.py:32,64` — `_DEPRECATED_PROVIDER_ALIASES`
- `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py:166`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_help_overview_coverage.py:58`, `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_exit_codes_doc_conformance.py:32`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry.py:28,197`, `tests/unit/test_cli_registry_cutover_s6_heldout.py:110` — `_HIDDEN_ALIASES`

Two further survivors are this story's own symbols in non-code prose, which deleting the machinery will not remove:

- `tests/unit/test_config_surface_golden.py:177` — a docstring recording that `_env_signature` *used to* make a second pass over `_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES`. Historical narration, correct as written.
- `tests/fixtures/cloud_adf_corpus/bodies_00.json` and `tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/table.json` — `_map_legacy_env` inside captured ticket-body prose used as bridge-rendering fixtures. Editing these would corrupt the fixtures.

AC1 needs to bind the whole identifier and exclude prose, for example anchoring the start (`\b_ALIASES\b` still matches `_ARCH_ALIASES`; `[^A-Z_]_ALIASES\b` or an explicit alternation of the three exact names is what is wanted) and restricting the paths to `src scripts` plus the named test modules, excluding `tests/fixtures`. The exact form is the implementer's call, but the current form is provably red on a correct implementation.

## 2. Part of the planned work is already done

`_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES` and `_map_legacy_env` **no longer exist anywhere in `src/`**. The Approach section's "Delete `src/rebar/_config_sources.py:330-339` (`_LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES` `:333`, `_map_legacy_env` `:336-339`)" has no target left; `_config_sources.py` on current main has `env_overrides` at `:296` and the unknown-keys policy read at `:317`, and neither alias symbol appears. The surviving references are only the docstring and the two fixtures in finding 1. Scope and file_impact should drop `_config_sources.py` unless something else in it is still needed.

## 3. Every line citation has drifted; substance is intact

Spot-checked the load-bearing claims — all three are **correct**, only mislocated:

| Cited | Actual on `origin/main` |
|---|---|
| `_tomb` hardcodes `_MAJOR` at `:196-199` | correct — `_tomb` is `:127-130`, `removed_in=_MAJOR` at `:129`, `_MAJOR = "v1.0.0"` at `:27` |
| `_MAJOR` stays for `_scheduled` `:62` | correct — `_scheduled` is `:42` |
| 7 warn env rows `:209-217` | all 7 present, at `:140,141,142,143,144,147,148` (non-contiguous) |
| 6 warn cfg rows `:226,227,231,236,240,241` | all 6 present, at `:157,158,162,164,168,169` |
| `file` error row | `:171`; `REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS` `:173`, `REBAR_LLM_MODEL` `:176`, `TICKETS_TRACKER_DIR` `:137`, `REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_RECONCILE_LIVE` `:138` |
| `_ALIASES` `:196-198` | `:200` |
| `_RESERVED_SECTIONS` `:209` | `:211` |
| reserved-section `continue` `:223-224` | `if sect in _RESERVED_SECTIONS:` at `:225` |
| alias consumer loop `:244-250` | `:245-249`; `warn_deprecated_cfg_keys` call is `:245` |
| `warn_deprecated` import `:22` | `:22` — correct |
| `coerce_sparse` | `:214` |
| `env_overrides` `:342-352` | `:296` |
| unknown-keys policy `:357-363` | `:317` |
| `config.py` imports `:9,45,56` | only `:9` carries `_ALIASES`; `:45,56` do not |
| `_env_signature` alias loop `:382-385` | `_env_signature` is `:279` |
| `_config_schema.py:32` | correct |
| `show_config.py:142-146` | `:142` |
| `show_config.py:129` reserved skip | correct |
| `show_config.py:180,182` templates | `:179-180` |
| `test_config_surface_golden.py:24` import | `_ALIASES` import is `:52`, used `:54` |

So the decisions in this plan hold up; the addresses do not. Re-measure the whole Approach/Scope/comment-1 block against the base this is actually implemented on before requesting review.

## Base stability

`ed5a` (this story's `depends_on`) touches **no** file in this story's scope — confirmed by diffing its branch against `origin/main`. So citations measured on current `origin/main` stay valid across ed5a's landing, and the re-measurement can be done now rather than after.

## Dependency note

The description states this story depends on the overlap epic's `overlap_*` removal story `09a8-5436-6b65-479c` (`granitic-realisable-dolphin`), because the exact-equality sync test would false-warn before it. That ticket is **closed**, so the prerequisite is satisfied — but there is no `depends_on` link recording it, only the one to `ed5a`. Worth linking for provenance even though it no longer gates.
